oracles.stl: awlsim (GPL-2.0-or-later, run from a local clone), with FC105 written in STL from Siemens' formula
oracles.scl: blind/scl-blind.mjs, a second interpreter written without seeing scl.mjs

checks.title: stl.mjs agrees with awlsim bit for bit
checks.compared: 43 input cases (20 raw levels x unipolar/bipolar, pump on/off, 3 multi-scan sequences), 56 scans, 6088 statements; MB 0-127, QB 0-15, ACCU1, ACCU2, AR1 and status word after every scan and ACCU1/2, AR1, status word after every statement: 32304 8-to-32-bit patterns (112 accumulator values, and status bits, left undefined by the FC105 call were not compared)

checks.title: scl.mjs agrees with the blind interpreter
checks.compared: 5 scan sequences, 91 scans; every output, static and "Rack" DB value after every scan (REAL bit for bit): 2002 values

checks.title: scl.mjs follows the hand-written state walk
checks.compared: state after every scan in 3 sequences, written by hand from the listing

checks.title: Every ruling sits on a line of its listing
